## RD-02 package contents — reduced-scope Alternative A

**Authority.** The owner-approved [registration](https://github.com/pedropaulofb/ontouml-directkg/commit/ef4b4498cb8b1d5f3f350b28e40758e863311aa2)
clarifies that absent Package.contents is accepted as empty under DK-GEN-06.
The existing DK-DIAG-05 structural policy governs malformed non-null non-array
containers: root unprocessability aborts under every policy; nested recovery
under best-effort omits affected contents, preserves independent elements, and
applies existing unresolved-reference rules. Malformed entries in valid arrays
are outside this assignment.

**Fixture and invocation.** The existing canonical shared/binary_relation
input supplies the independent class and relation graph. A runtime-only
nested package receives a valid-looking Class as a non-array object, a string,
zero, or false. Empty representations are compared with an empty-array control.
A distinct dependent relation references a class that cannot be discovered in
the omitted nested contents. A focused adapter reader checks native severity,
reason and package context, without prescribing a provisional diagnostic code.
The CLI and Python report comparisons use actual produced records and actual
report I/O. No stored fixture or expectation was added or moved.

Collection yielded 5,991 nodes, preserving 5,934 existing IDs and adding 57.
The targeted selection yielded 24 passed and 33 test-first failures. The
empty-content cases passed; malformed containers encountered the existing
source-indexing NotImplementedError and INTERNAL_TRANSFORMATION_FAILURE
rather than the required structural diagnostic or local recovery.
All 210 selected existing regressions passed on both base and candidate.
No full-suite execution. Pending independent Test Reviewer review.

### F1–F2 correction after independent review of `3315610a65e927cc206fc934d97039ad18d76acc`

- **F1.** Complete affirmative native claims about malformed contents containers
  are bound to the reported package context. Negation, unrelated identifier or
  entry errors, alternatives, and bare requirements do not establish the
  condition. All three reviewer counterexamples reproduced on the base and
  were rejected by the correction.
- **F2.** Root-container unprocessability requires `UNPROCESSABLE_DOCUMENT`.
  Local nested-container failure requires a nonempty provisional identifier,
  and the existing nested outcome, dependent-reference and interface cases
  exclude `UNPROCESSABLE_DOCUMENT`. The reviewer's incorrect nested stable-code
  probe passed the base and was rejected by the correction.

**Authority.** Owner-approved registration at `c87a6a2cd83f6da675018edb1b0af81f86ad7013`
(parent/base `3315610a65e927cc206fc934d97039ad18d76acc`), with forwarded
Architect unified handoff and independent Architect Reviewer **OK** (`Findings: None`).
Governing specification `documentation/specification/transformation-specification.md`,
blob `c8d55b57a9dea65b43c353c93afcd7611d859817` (**Consolidated:** `2026-11-23`);
structure `documentation/specification/test-suite-structure.md`, blob
`ae7a5f3b392a90db8baacf938460314c87de9698`. Preserves `DK-DIAG-04` eight-code
core and `§15` configuration surface (verified by existing
`test_relation_properties_container_adds_no_new_cli_or_python_controls`).

**Supersession.** Under RD-02 Alternative 2A, objects lacking a valid nonempty
string `type` inside `Package.contents` emit a structural `ERROR` under `DK-DIAG-05`
rather than `UNKNOWN_INFORMATION`. The 4 existing `untyped_location` rows above
(`test_shared_json_contract_python_export_preserves_required_fields_and_actual_events[untyped_location]`
and `test_shared_json_contract_cli_export_mirrors_native_events_despite_console_filtering[untyped_location-{error,info,warning}]`)
were updated to expect `aborted` and `ERROR` under default `tolerant` policy.

**Adapter bindings.** `tests/support/invocation.py` adds affirmative semantic
diagnostic readers (`_package_contents_entry_facts` / `package_contents_entry_diagnostic`,
`_class_properties_container_facts` / `class_properties_container_diagnostic`, and
`_non_enum_literals_facts` / `non_enum_literals_diagnostic`) without fixing
provisional diagnostic codes, rejecting internal/deferred-guard wording, conditionals,
hedges, negations, and unrelated subjects.
